plan.title: feat(dashboard): generic file attachment in conversation composer (+ button and drag-and-drop)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

references.label: PRD draft (glossary, verified references, decisions D1-D13, FR-1..FR-7)

narratives.Problem: The conversation composer supports only image attachment, via two undiscoverable paths (paste, drag-and-drop). Non-image files are silently ignored at three layers: the handleDrop image filter (ComposerFooter.tsx:304), the composerStore enqueue filter (composerStore.ts:288), and the server's four-image-MIME allowlist (conversation-message.ts:66-71). There is no visible attach affordance at all.
narratives.Proposal: Add a Paperclip attach button (hidden multi-file input) and broaden drag-and-drop to a curated, extension-driven allowlist of text/code types plus PDF (operator-confirmed). Server validates text uploads as fatal-UTF-8 with no NUL bytes and PDFs by %PDF- magic, keeping the uniform 5 MiB cap and all image validation unchanged. Rename the composer's image-specific store/UI to attachment terminology with a kind:'image'|'file' field (operator-confirmed); non-image attachments render as a file chip (icon, name, size, remove). Keep the @<serverPath> send-token convention; make vision gating image-only at both the frontend enqueue gate and the server send-path strip so text/PDF deliver to any model. Full decisions D1-D13 and verified line references in .pan/drafts/PAN-2596.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No structured attachments field on ChatMessage or any packages/contracts/ change
- No renaming/adding HTTP endpoints: /upload-image and /delete-image keep their paths
- No per-type size caps; MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES and multipart route limits unchanged
- No paste-semantics changes beyond mechanical renames (file-manager paste stays unsupported with its existing toast)
- No support for extension-less files or dotfiles (.env, Makefile) — rejected with a named toast
- No binary formats beyond PDF (no docx/xlsx/zip/audio/video)
- No timeline-rendering changes for sent attachments (@path stays plain text)
- No reload durability for pending attachments (#1592)
- No changes to the rate limiter, path-containment checks, or attachment cleanup/reaper (already type-agnostic)

autoDecisions.summary: Non-image stored filenames embed a sanitized original basename: <uuid>-<sanitized-basename><ext>, lowercased, [a-z0-9._-] only, capped at 48 chars (D12). Images keep <uuid><ext>.
autoDecisions.rationale: An agent reading @/…/3f2a….log loses all semantic context under pure-UUID naming; embedding the sanitized name is one small helper, keeps UUID uniqueness, and stays within the allowlisted-extension safety envelope.

autoDecisions.summary: Endpoint paths /upload-image and /delete-image are kept unchanged (D8).
autoDecisions.rationale: They are already generic multipart/JSON endpoints, the frontend is their only caller, and renaming would churn the conversations-no-loss route audit for zero behavior gain.

autoDecisions.summary: Paste remains image-focused; the picker and drag-and-drop are the generic-file entry points.
autoDecisions.rationale: OS file-manager paste arrives as text/uri-list which web origins cannot read (existing handled case); broadening paste has no reachable new input.

items.title: Server: extension-driven upload allowlist with UTF-8/PDF content validation

narrative.Action: In src/lib/overdeck/conversation-message.ts: (1) add exported ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS covering .txt .md .markdown .json .jsonl .log .csv .tsv .yaml .yml .toml .xml .html .css .js .jsx .ts .tsx .py .sh .bash .sql .diff .patch .ini .conf .cfg plus .pdf, alongside the UNTOUCHED image ALLOWED_UPLOAD_MIME_TYPES map; (2) export IMAGE_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS ('.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.gif','.webp') and isImageAttachmentPath(path) (lowercased-extension test); (3) extract the validation into an exported pure helper validateUploadPayload(filename, mimeType, bytes) used by handleConversationImageUpload: image MIME -> existing magic-byte path unchanged; else dispatch on extname(filename).toLowerCase(): '.pdf' -> bytes must start with %PDF- (0x25 0x50 0x44 0x46 0x2D); text extension -> new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}) must decode and bytes must contain no 0x00; anything else -> 400 'Unsupported file type: <ext-or-mime>'; (4) safeUploadExtension returns the original lowercased extension for non-image allowlisted files; (5) non-image stored filename becomes `${randomUUID()}-${sanitize(basenameWithoutExt)}${ext}` with sanitize = lowercase, keep [a-z0-9._-], cap 48 chars, fallback 'file' (images keep `${randomUUID()}${ext}`). Uniform MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (5 MiB) unchanged. New test file tests/unit/lib/overdeck/conversation-upload-validation.test.ts unit-tests the pure helper (no fs/db stubs needed). Repo rule: no execSync; pure/sync code only.

items.title: Given a .md file with valid UTF-8 bytes, validateUploadPayload accepts it and handleConversationImageUpload returns 200 with a path ending in -<sanitized-name>.md
Given a .txt filename whose bytes are invalid UTF-8 or contain a NUL byte, the upload is rejected with a 400 naming the content mismatch
Given a .pdf whose bytes start with %PDF- the upload is accepted; given a .pdf without that prefix it is rejected with 400
Given a disallowed extension (.exe) or an extension-less filename, the upload is rejected with a 400 that names the unsupported type

Image upload behavior is preserved: each of the four image MIME types still validates its magic bytes, keeps <uuid><ext> naming, and the handler rejects a PNG-declared payload carrying JPEG bytes with 400
Server: strip only image attachments for non-vision models; generalize harness transform wording

Add tests to the same test file: extract/exercise via exported functions (transformMessageForHarness is already exported; test the partition logic through it plus isImageAttachmentPath).

items.title: Given a non-vision model and a message referencing a managed .md attachment, the delivered message preserves the @path token (nothing stripped, no 422)
Given a non-vision model and a message with one image and one .txt attachment, the response reports imagesDropped: 1 and the delivered message retains only the .txt @path

Frontend: attachment-terminology rename, kind field, generic enqueue, allowlist mirror module

narrative.Action: (1) Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/attachmentTypes.ts mirroring the server allowlist from server-upload-allowlist (cross-reference comments both directions, precedent: modelSupportsImages mirrors modelSupportsImagesSync): export ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS, classifyAttachmentKind(file): 'image'|'file'|null (image = file.type.startsWith('image/'); file = allowlisted extension; null = rejected), inferAttachmentMime(file): string (extension->MIME table because browsers report empty MIME for .log/.md/.toml and video/mp2t for .ts; default text/plain), ATTACHMENT_ACCEPT (comma-joined 'image/*' + extensions) for the picker. (2) In composerStore.ts rename PendingImage->PendingAttachment adding kind: 'image'|'file' and making previewUrl string|null (URL.createObjectURL only for kind 'image'); rename enqueueImages->enqueueAttachments, removeImage->removeAttachment, updateImage->updateAttachment, consumeImages->consumeAttachments, useConversationImages->useConversationAttachments, getConversationImages->getConversationAttachments, slice field images->attachments; enqueueAttachments(conversationName, files) classifies each file, enqueues allowed, and RETURNS { rejected: File[] }; the upload FormData uses inferAttachmentMime(file) for kind 'file' and file.type for images. Preserve upload-pump semantics exactly (3-concurrent, orphan-delete on remove-during-flight, consume-on-send does not delete server files). (3) In ComposerFooter.tsx apply mechanical renames only (gate/toast behavior changes belong to composer-drop-and-gate); guard the strip's on previewUrl so kind:'file' renders without crashing until composer-file-chip lands. (4) Update both test files for the renames; add store tests for kind classification, inferred MIME, rejected return, and unchanged orphan-delete semantics. No-loss rule: every existing image affordance (queue, preview, remove, error-retry, unmount survival, send-splice) must still be exercised by tests after the rename.

items.title: Given a .md File, enqueueAttachments creates a PendingAttachment with kind 'file' and null previewUrl, and the upload POST sends MIME text/markdown inferred from the extension
enqueueAttachments with a .exe File enqueues nothing and returns it in the rejected array
Image enqueue preserves existing behavior: kind 'image', object-URL preview, and removing an attachment mid-upload still deletes the server orphan when the upload completes
After the rename, composerStore.ts contains no exported identifier matching *Image*, and both existing frontend test suites pass against the renamed API

items.title: The toolbar renders a Paperclip button with aria-label 'Attach files' that is disabled when the session is not alive
When files are selected via the hidden input, they are enqueued into the conversation's attachment queue (visible in the strip) and the input value resets to empty
The hidden input contains the multiple attribute and an accept attribute derived from ATTACHMENT_ACCEPT (images + allowlisted extensions)
Frontend: generic drag-and-drop, rejection toasts, image-only vision gate

narrative.Action: In ComposerFooter.tsx: (1) rework the :130-140 enqueue wrapper into the single shared entry point for picker/drop/paste: when !modelSupportsImages(model), partition out kind-'image' files, fire the existing warning toast for them, and CONTINUE enqueueing the remaining files (today the whole batch is dropped); call the store's enqueueAttachments and toast.error naming each rejected file from the returned rejected array (D11: no silent drops); (2) in handleDrop (:301-307) remove the image/* filter and pass every dropped file to the wrapper (handleDragOver already accepts any file-kind drag and needs no change); (3) handlePaste keeps its image-harvest logic but routes through the same wrapper. Tests: dropping a .log queues it; dropping a .exe queues nothing and shows a toast naming it; with a non-vision model, dropping an image plus a .txt queues the .txt and warns only about the image.

items.title: When an allowlisted non-image file (.log) is dropped onto the composer box, it renders in the attachment strip as a queued attachment
Dropping a disallowed file (.exe) queues nothing and renders a rejection toast that names the file
With a non-vision model, dropping an image and a .txt together queues the .txt, drops the image, and shows the image-specific warning toast
